claim: The reminder lane reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context; visit once, wait for service-worker control, disconnect, reload, and assert saved UI remains usable

claim: Imports keep reminders independently addressable even when backup IDs are duplicate or Java-hash-colliding.
sandbox: fresh IndexedDB; import duplicate IDs plus Aa/BB, assert deterministic unique row IDs, then edit only one duplicate

claim: The free tier arms at most three reminders while preserving extra imported reminders as paused.
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser; import four enabled reminders and assert four rows, three active, and one visibly paused

claim: Ordinary reminder data stays on the device without analytics or tracking requests.
sandbox: fresh browser; record all requests while creating, persisting, and reloading a reminder; assert same-origin only

claim: The Android app re-arms a due reminder repeat from persisted native state without a running web timer.
sandbox: Robolectric API 30; persist due native state, invoke the alarm receiver path, and assert AlarmManager holds the next five-minute repeat

claim: The published Android APK downloads and matches the displayed SHA-256 digest.
sandbox: local production server; download the linked APK, assert it is over 1 MB, and compare its bytes with the displayed digest

claim: US$4.99 is a one-time purchase for unlimited active reminders through Sociobot checkout.
sandbox: fresh unlicensed browser; assert exact price, one-time copy, and the registered Sociobot checkout URL
